title: Course Registration Freeze
description: Temporarily freeze your course registration for the current semester.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason for Freeze
fields.placeholder: Please explain why you need to freeze your registration...

info: Your advisor will be notified upon submission. Processing takes 2-3 business days.

title: Leave of Absence Request
description: Apply for a temporary leave from the university for medical or personal reasons.
info: A supporting document (e.g. medical report) may be required.

title: Course Add / Drop
description: Add a new course or drop an existing one within the allowed period.
info: Add/Drop requests are subject to availability and advisor approval.

title: Transcript Request
description: Request an official or unofficial transcript to be sent to an institution.
info: Official transcripts are mailed directly to the institution. Allow 5-7 business days.

title: Exam Excuse Application
description: Apply for a makeup exam if you missed a scheduled exam due to a valid reason.
info: Supporting documentation must be submitted within 3 days of the original exam date.

title: Graduation Application
description: Submit your application to graduate at the end of this academic term.
info: The application period for this term has closed.

title: Dormitory Application
description: Apply for on-campus housing for the upcoming academic year.
info: Reapplication is possible for the next term.

title: Name / ID Update Request
description: Request an update to your personal information in the university system.
info: A valid government-issued ID may be required.
